title: Launch your sci-fi binge with these top streaming deals I found during Prime Day
summary: Are you trying to avoid the temptation of Prime Day? From Project Hail Mary to Superman, we've got the best summer streaming deals to see you through.
contentText:
Not found what you want this Prime Day ? That's where our round-up of the best summer streaming deals comes in, from HBO Max to Paramount Plus and beyond.

Admittedly, a couple of these deals may put a few pennies in Jeff's pocket, but take advantage of these deals and you can shut out Prime Day and lose yourself in a world of sci-fi and superheroes.

Save 50% on a combined six-month Disney Plus and Hulu bundle, netting you access to the whole Star Wars library, Marvel Cinematic Universes, every Alien and Predator movie and show and beyond. View Deal

Paramount Plus is the undisputed home of Star Trek, from old trek to Star Trek New worlds and you can watch two months for just $1 a month. View Deal

Missed out on the brilliant Project Hail Mary ? It and plenty of other sci-fi content is available on MGM+ and, via Prime Video, you can watch two months for just $1 a month, after which it's $8. View Deal

HBO Max offers three tiers, including ad-free and ad-supported options, and you can save as much as $65 by paying annually. Aside from virtually the whole DC universe (including James Gunn's Superman), HBO Max offers movies like Ready Player One, the Terminator and more. View Deal

Save a huge $46 on STARZ which, while not as famous as Disney Plus, boasts a host of sci-fi content such as Outlander and The Listeners. Several of Sony's Spider-Man movies are also available to stream. View Deal

Traditionally the home of The Walking Dead, and its spin-offs, AMC Plus offers a wealth of zombie-free sci-fi content too and, right now, you can get a 7 day free trial. That's enough time to binge Snowpiercer, Orphan Black and more. View Deal
